name: gaming-mcp
description: Sovereign Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling LLM agents to observe and control video games via Universal Computer Use (DXGI zero-copy screen capture, Win32 hardware scan codes, ViGEmBus virtual gamepad) and high-fidelity game bridges (Minecraft, Libretro, Gymnasium).

adapters.name: Universal VLA Computer Use
adapters.description: Universal OS-level screen capture, hardware scan codes, and ViGEmBus virtual gamepad actuation.

adapters.name: Minecraft Bridge
adapters.description: Node.js Mineflayer IPC bridge providing 3D voxel navigation, block harvesting, and recipe crafting.

adapters.name: Retro Emulation Adapter
adapters.description: Libretro and stable-retro emulator core bindings with RAM introspection and state snapshotting.

adapters.name: Gymnasium RL Adapter
adapters.description: OpenAI Gymnasium reinforcement learning environment wrapper with space introspection and stepping.
